Independently check the explicitly proposed profileθ(t)=15+80e^(−t/160):its initial temperature is95andinitial derivative−0.5. Its derivative equals−(θ−15)/160andits limit is15. This checks a candidate model without requiring a general ODE-solving method.

Under equal heat capacities and10percent milk as a fraction of the final mixture,the immediate mixture is0.9·95+0.1·5=86°C. Its excess above room temperature is71,so the source key’s profile15+71e^(−t/160)is correct under this convention. If10percent instead means milk volume relative to the original coffee,the excess is790/11,not71;record the convention rather than flagging an unconditional key error.
